ops.title: Avoid repeated large-tip decode on parent-cache fallback
ops.description: Owner /root/current_host_relief. Queued after parent4542 first genuine installed proof; this is not a release gate for the first exact-parent cache repair. Source refuter bf13 C1: eager ReadCommit decodes the tip before root/merge/checkpoint/parent-cache eligibility is known. A packed ops blob larger than65536 bytes is streamed without object-cache admission, so a refused/ineligible probe followed by original ReadChain may read/decode that one head payload again. This is extra one-head logical work, not another whole-history pass and not proof of sampled PID78697 100MB IO. Next executable step after first installed proof: add a private >64KiB packed-head/ineligible-parent-miss CI lens, compare full snapshots/native request+payload work, then assess minimal reuse of the already decoded immutable head while preserving existing backfill/cancellation/tolerant errors. No new backend/cacheformat/DDL or current seeded-reader API redesign is authorized by this record.

ops.text: After parent first installed proof, source-bind and CI-grade a private packed tip ops payload >65536 bytes with an ineligible/missing cached parent; require full snapshot parity and quantify exactly extra head requests/decodes, keeping physical IO and historical sampled attribution UNKNOWN.

If the bounded counterexample remains actionable, freeze the smallest existing-reader reuse candidate with independent source peer; preserve root/merge/checkpoint/skipped-op/unknown-kind/missing-object/backfill/cancel and child-scope custody, without changing backend/cache formats.

Carry any accepted follow-up separately through normal CI, merge, genuine release, local CLI installation and private affected-case verification before closing; keep this queued follow-up out of parent first-fix release gates.
